items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: No, I don't remember playing with him.

ctx.x: Did you ever play with, we talked to all of the losers in the last week or so, Peter Lacazze, did you ever play with him?
No, I don't remember playing with him. But all the regular guys, Nelson, the trombone player, George Nelson. That's his brother, huh?
